description: Parse and validate a BCP 47 language tag against the IANA Language Subtag Registry, or search subtags by description. Pass exactly one of `tag` (e.g. "zh-Hant-TW", "sr-Latn", "en_US") or `description` (e.g. "Swiss German"). A tag is split into language, extlang, script, region, variant, extension, and private-use parts; each part is checked, deprecated subtags report their preferred value, and a canonical tag is returned when the tag is valid. A single subtag registered under several types (e.g. "TW") lists the other types.

description.description: Words matched as whole tokens against subtag descriptions, e.g. "Swiss German" or "Cyrillic". Pass this or tag, not both.

limit.description: Maximum number of description matches to return, 1–100. Default 25. Tag mode always returns every part of the tag.

offset.description: Number of description matches to skip; pass the next_offset of the previous response to get the next page. Default 0.

subtag_type.description: Description mode only: return only records of this Type.

tag.description: A language tag to validate, e.g. "zh-Hant-TW", "sr-Latn", "i-klingon". Underscores are read as hyphens ("en_US" → "en-US"); matching ignores case. Pass this or description, not both.

name: iana_lookup_language_tag

also_registered_as.description: Tag mode, single-subtag input: records of other types under the same subtag, e.g. region "TW" beside language "tw".

deprecated.description: Date deprecated, YYYY-MM-DD; still valid, but prefer preferred_value.

preferred_value.description: The subtag or tag to use instead.

prefixes.description: Prefix values: the tags this extlang or variant follows.

subtag.description: Subtag; the whole tag for grandfathered/redundant; a range such as "qaa..qtz".

suppress_script.description: Script subtag this language normally omits, e.g. "Latn".

canonical_tag.description: Tag mode, valid tags only: canonical form (preferred values applied, extlang reduced, case normalized).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `mode_required`: Neither or both of tag and description were given. `upstream_unreadable`: The language subtag registry could not be fetched or parsed to zero records. `pacer_shed`: This server's own iana.org request queue is too full for the call to start in time. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

issues.description: Tag mode: findings; empty for a clean tag.

kind.description: unknown (not registered for its position) and wrong_position (misplaced, repeated, or an extlang after the wrong language) make the tag invalid; the rest are advisory.

message.description: What is wrong and what to use instead.

subtag.description: The subtag or sequence the issue is about.

matches.description: Description mode: matching records, exact description matches first, then registry order.

deprecated.description: Date deprecated, YYYY-MM-DD; still valid, but prefer preferred_value.

preferred_value.description: The subtag or tag to use instead.

prefixes.description: Prefix values: the tags this extlang or variant follows.

subtag.description: Subtag; the whole tag for grandfathered/redundant; a range such as "qaa..qtz".

suppress_script.description: Script subtag this language normally omits, e.g. "Latn".

next_offset.description: Pass as offset for the next page; absent on the last.

notice.description: Guidance on a miss, a cut list, or another condition.

source.description: Provenance and freshness of the answer.

fetched_at.description: ISO 8601 time of the last successful fetch or revalidation.

registry_id.description: Id of the registry file that answered.

registry_updated.description: The registry's own last-updated date; absent for the protocol index.

stale.description: True when a refresh failed and a cached copy up to 7 days old answered.

subtags.description: Tag mode: the parts in order, after any whole-tag record; parsing stops at the first part the syntax cannot place.

deprecated.description: Date deprecated, YYYY-MM-DD; still valid, but prefer preferred_value.

position.description: Position in the tag; grandfathered/redundant for a whole-tag record.

preferred_value.description: The subtag or tag to use instead.

prefixes.description: Prefix values: the tags this extlang or variant follows.

registered.description: True when a record covers the subtag at this position (private-use ranges count); always false for extension and private-use parts.

subtag.description: Subtag in canonical case; the whole sequence of an extension or private-use part; the whole tag for grandfathered/redundant.

suppress_script.description: Script subtag this language normally omits, e.g. "Latn".

tag_input.description: Tag mode: the tag as read, after underscores became hyphens.

totalCount.description: Matches before the limit was applied.

truncated.description: True when more matches exist than were returned.

valid.description: Tag mode: true when well-formed, every subtag is registered and correctly placed, and no variant or singleton repeats.

well_formed.description: Tag mode: true when the tag follows RFC 5646 syntax or is grandfathered.

title: Validate a BCP 47 language tag
